findings.location: Goal; Completion criteria 4 and 6; Verification for the plan as a whole
findings.problem: The plan promises that no window ends after midnight, but preserves checks only between model calls and leaves the window's work unchanged. The cited spec explicitly permits a window to overrun its deadline by an in-flight model call. An embedding call started before midnight can finish afterward, so merely clipping the deadline cannot satisfy the promised log acceptance. This is distinct from the earlier scheduler finding: even the active window cannot guarantee the stated finish time.
findings.suggestion: Define midnight as the deadline after which no further work starts, explicitly allowing existing in-flight work to finish, and update the goal, criteria and log acceptance accordingly. Add a test whose model call crosses midnight and verifies that no subsequent call starts. If an absolute finish by midnight is required, plan the additional enforcement needed.

summary: The midnight finish guarantee conflicts with the preserved cooperative deadline behavior and the cited spec.
